National Geographic’s picks for Best of the World 2027 are here and features 25 destinations across six continents. 

Whether you're drawn to places steeped in history or the thrill of exploring the wild, there's no shortage of experiences worth planning a trip around. 

Find your next adventure and see our full #BestOfTheWorld 2027 guide at the link in bio. 

Photograph by Thomas Ekström".
